name: Swarmkeeper Xvarcon

abilities.name: Shock
abilities.description: A basic ranged attack that does minor shock damage.

abilities.name: Thunder Thrall
abilities.description: The enemy teleports to you and summons a bolt of lightning that strikes a large area around itself. This attack does moderate shock damage to all targets as indicated by the red circle.

abilities.name: Crush Crawler
abilities.description: Swarmkeeper Xvarcon casts an explosion on itself dealing moderate-high magic damage in an area.

abilities.name: Toss Crawler
abilities.description: Swarmkeeper Xvarcon throws a Mirrorworm under the target. The Mirrorworm explodes after a small delay.

abilities.name: Summon Prism Wasp
abilities.description: Swarmkeeper Xvarcon summons two to four Crystaljacks to fight for him. Those Crystaljacks die after some time and always explode on death after a small delay.

abilities.name: Run Away!
abilities.description: When too close to them, the storm mage backs up to put some distance between their target and themselves.

summary: Swarmkeeper Xvarcon is a Shardborn Dremora who serves as one of the champions of Leftwheal Trading Post.
